info.name: OAN DA Services - DA Registry
info.description:
Every DA Services API that reads or writes the DA Registry. DA Services is a wrapper: it checks the caller's DA Services RBAC (DA: own record, Supervisor: Woreda, Executive: Region/Zone, Admin: all), then calls the DA Registry staff API with the caller's own staff IAM access token and CSRF value.

Every request sends `Authorization: Bearer {{access_token}}` and `X-CSRF-Token: {{csrf_token}}`.

How to run: set username and password in the environment, run folder 0 (sign in), then the folder for the user's role. The token lives 5 minutes on dev: run folder 0 again on a 401. Add keycloak.development.oanstaging.com and staff-iam.development.oanstaging.com to Cookies > Domains allowlist so 0.1 can clear old sessions.

DA Services roles come from the staff IAM token: the Keycloak user's client roles on `oan-client` (Supervisor, OAN Administrator, ...) plus the login option's default role (Development Agent); roles added by hand in DA Services are reset at the next sign-in. The user also needs a DA Services DA RBAC Assignment (a DA's assignment carries their DA-ID) and the DA Registry roles for the calls (Data Editor to read DAs and open change requests, Intake Officer to import, Integration Manager for the exceptions list).

Requests 2.6 (Approve) and 3.3 write to the DA Registry.
